decode_note: image-metrics.mjs reads PNG only (pngjs). Every reference file was decoded to PNG in a scratch directory and the PNG was measured. Decoding is lossless with respect to the stored pixels, so these numbers are the statistics of the exact committed bytes; the committed files themselves were never rewritten. AVIF and JPEG decode was PIL 12.3.0.
population_note: Populations are the folders that exist, not the profile folders of REFERENCE-IMAGE-REQUEST §3 — none of exterior_daylight, exterior_lowlight, interior_darkemissive, combat or material_closeup was ever filled, so no per-profile band can be computed from this set. "rejected" is measured only so the rejection log can quote a failing statistic; it is not a band and must never be cited as one.
metric_name_warning: These names are the RI-VIS03 metric IDs of the NEAREST equivalent statistic, not the RI-VIS03 definitions. See RI-VIS09 §5 for the exact differences (FFT crop size, band edges, tile size, absence of FG_MASK). Do not paste these numbers into RI-VIS03 as bands.
